hypothesis: Loaded-session RSS is materially dominated by repeated short owned string fields (role, model id, tool name, MIME/key names) and would benefit from scoped interning/arena.
approach: No product change: baseline VM release build, five loaded-session RSS/PSS trials, per-process smaps_rollup inspection, native fixture cardinality census. Analyzing 7,395-row 10MiB session found 58,617 short (<24-byte) values containing 517,969 bytes and 133,897 JSON keys; a ~32-byte-per-allocation upper-order estimate puts short-value allocator headers at 1.79MiB per retained copy, plus 0.49MiB payload. Typed SessionEntry.type_ changes would be smaller still. Paired candidate build was not justified; aborted neighbor suites after first cold-open trial had started (zero neighbor rows). Bench fixture mutation/stale-manifest reported to perf-open-audit-sol, who owns harness fix.
parity_notes: No product source, runtime, API, wire format, feature, prompt, session replay, macOS or Linux behavior changed. No candidate exists.

validity.notes: 5/5 benchmark row application-level validated (sentinel true and echoed), distinct new process trees each trial; strict byte-identical-fixture validity FAILS: bench manifest claimed original 10,485,760 bytes SHA dadaecfcac511e24ed0e0df15fb1facbe556557856486d62bad628250194cdda each trial, but product appended thinking_level_change + service_tier_change + session_state on first attach, then one session_state each subsequent attach. End fixture 10,487,224 bytes SHA 34655deda22774604931155eda122434426a3c7409617d227fb7a7a62d5abf46. 1,464 appended bytes cannot plausibly explain the 59.7MiB RSS spread; drift cause UNKNOWN, not called a leak. Bundled product.yaml revision 7152746b9 is stale; actual VM git HEAD asserted 1b3fe3791 and binary SHA matches versions.json. No A/A; no candidate because hypothesis weak. Cold-open first trial interrupted via SIGINT after five memory rows completed, no neighbor values; avoid claiming PR-grade performance result.

decision: Worker recommends discard without edit: repeated short-string allocation ceiling (~2–3MiB per copy) is small relative to 485.4–545.1MiB RSS and 59.7MiB spread; fixture bytes not identical; no meaningful performance gain established. Parent acknowledged negative-result plan; final owner approval pending publication.
